tools.name: broker_status
tools.description: Report the strongroom egress broker base URL and whether it is listening. Lease-backed URLs are broker_base + "/" + <lease>.

tools.name: grant_lease
tools.description: Mint a scoped, expiring, revocable lease for a stored secret and return a lease-backed base URL. Point your HTTP client at base_url and call the upstream with NO key — the broker injects the real secret at the network boundary. The raw API key is never returned and never crosses the MCP wire.

secret.description: Name of a secret already in the vault (see list_secrets). The value is never exposed.

upstream.description: Upstream base URL the secret may be injected toward, e.g. https://api.example.com. The lease is bound to this host.

ttl_s.description: Lease lifetime in seconds (default 300). Capped by STRONGROOM_MAX_TTL if set.

uses.description: Number of times the lease may be redeemed (default 1). Capped by STRONGROOM_MAX_USES if set.

inject.description: How to inject the secret upstream: 'bearer' (Authorization: Bearer) or 'x-api-key' (default bearer).

paths.description: Glob path allowlist scoping which endpoints the lease may hit, e.g. ['/v1/chat/*']. Empty = any path on the upstream host.

rate.description: Requests-per-minute cap for this lease (default unlimited).

concurrency.description: Max simultaneous in-flight requests for this lease (default unlimited).

tools.name: list_leases
tools.description: List outstanding leases by fingerprint, with their secret name, uses remaining, and expiry. Raw lease ids are never stored or returned.

tools.name: list_secrets
tools.description: List the names of secrets in the vault. Values are never returned — only names you can grant a lease against.

tools.name: revoke_lease
tools.description: Revoke a lease immediately by its raw lease id or its lease-backed base URL. The capability dies at once; the real secret is untouched.

lease.description: The raw lease id, or the lease-backed base_url returned by grant_lease.
